transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to hold our staffing huddle to assign substitutes for next Friday's professional-development day. We have four teachers out: Ms. Brooks in Algebra II, Mr. Chen in Biology Lab, Ms. Diaz in sixth-grade inclusion, and Ms. Ellis in Ceramics. Our available substitutes are Jordan Lee, Priya Shah, Morgan Reed, and Taylor Kim. Before we propose a roster for Dr. Collins' approval, I'd like to hear from each of you regarding any qualification or safety requirements for the rooms connected to your work. Let's start with the special education coordinator on Ms. Diaz's sixth-grade inclusion coverage.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical requirement for Ms. Diaz's sixth-grade inclusion class. I've confirmed from the student's active service plan that this class requires a substitute with current special-education certification. Morgan Reed is the only available substitute who holds that certification. I should also note that the staffing office has not yet received the updated qualification list, so this certification requirement may not be reflected in their records.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical health and safety requirement for Mr. Chen's Biology Lab. I've reviewed the health plans and district training records, and that class includes a student whose seizure-response protocol requires the classroom substitute to have completed the district seizure-response module. Priya Shah is the only available substitute who has completed that module. I should also note that the training record has not yet been attached to the coverage request, so this requirement may not be visible in the staffing office's current records.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Ortiz, Ms. Nguyen, and Nurse Brooks. So far we have two critical requirements flagged: Morgan Reed must be assigned to Ms. Diaz's sixth-grade inclusion class due to special-education certification, and Priya Shah must be assigned to Mr. Chen's Biology Lab due to the seizure-response module completion. I'd like to hear from the remaining reviewers before we finalize the roster. Have the department chair or principal identified any qualification or safety requirements for the Algebra II and Ceramics rooms?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety requirement for Ms. Ellis's Ceramics room. I've inspected the room and confirmed that the substitute covering Ms. Ellis must have completed the kiln-supervision practicum before students may use the kiln. Taylor Kim is the only available substitute who has completed that practicum. I should also note that the department's equipment checklist has not yet been forwarded to Human Resources, so this requirement may not be reflected in their current records.
transcript.speaker: A5

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical qualification requirement for Ms. Brooks's Algebra II class. I reviewed the personnel files this morning and confirmed that Jordan Lee holds the current secondary mathematics certification required to cover Algebra II. Jordan Lee is the only available substitute with that certification. I should note that the certification note has not yet been added to the substitute roster, so this requirement may not be visible in the staffing office's current records.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, everyone. It looks like all four rooms now have a critical requirement flagged, and each one maps to exactly one of our four available substitutes. To summarize: Morgan Reed to Ms. Diaz's sixth-grade inclusion class for special-education certification, Priya Shah to Mr. Chen's Biology Lab for the seizure-response module, Taylor Kim to Ms. Ellis's Ceramics room for the kiln-supervision practicum, and Jordan Lee to Ms. Brooks's Algebra II class for secondary mathematics certification. Every substitute is uniquely matched, and all four requirements have been raised in this huddle. I believe we're ready for Dr. Collins to issue the binding approval on this roster.
transcript.speaker: A3
